You also have the chance of a permanent contract after 10 weeks! Nice, right?! Is this your new job at Kuehne + Nagel in Tilburg?!Sign up now and receive a WhatsApp message within 15 minutes with a few short questions so we can help you quickly. Don't have a WhatsApp?
